title: Python: A1 star re-export module attribute (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23) step 4)
description: Admitted group A1: attribute access on a module whose names come from a star re-export. Complete-export-set logic, last binding in module order wins, incomplete set unresolved. Fixtures red before, green after. Held-out samples stay spent; python-gate fenced.
implementationNotes: A1 built (DEC-303 (a22) item 3): resolveStarAttribute in src/python/calls.ts, called from resolveModuleAttribute when no binding of the module carries the name; stars walked in module order, last that can supply the name wins, an incomplete star (unresolved, external, non-literal __all__) leaves it unresolved unless a later complete star exports the name. 11 new fixtures in test/python-calls.test.ts (addition only); 6 positives red without the src change, negatives green both ways. Measurement with markerDirsFor over the five pins: flask, jinja, rich, tqdm unchanged (0 in-package effect); httpx resolvedInRepo 593->1733, nameNotBound 937->54, receiverNeedsInference 1270->1020, resolvedExternal 1389->1382; all 1142 new sites are in tests/, none in the package: the 883 A1 sites plus about 257 knock-on sites where a local bound by httpx.Client(...) is now a known class. A1's in-package value stays unmeasured.

ROUND 1 FIXES (review of 2a40dfa). R1: resolveStarAttribute now consults the holder's module scope (lookupBindings) first; an assign, for, with or except-as binding of the name keeps the call unresolved (rebound). R2: the selected star is resolved through resolveStarBound (rule 33), so a rebinding in the star source is seen, and carries its own visited set and hop bound per call (this also fixes the N1 diamond false negative: the old shared visited set made the second branch read a cycle). Stars are read last to first (rule 45). Fixtures added: holder rebinding x4, source rebinding, diamond, a complete-star cycle with literal __all__ naming an undefined name, and a class base pkg.Base reaching an inherited method; R1, R2 and the diamond are red against the round-1 code. KNOWN GAPS, as for bare names: a def or import in the holder BEFORE the star beats the star though in Python the later one wins (true before this PR); a star import's condition (try/except) is ignored and the last star is picked (same as resolveUnbound). KNOCK-ONS: class bases written pkg.Name now resolve, changing the MRO for inherited and super calls; the eight sites that left the external bin are super().__enter__/__exit__/__aenter__/__aexit__ in tests/client/test_client.py:245,249,277,281 and test_async_client.py:196,200,229,233, where the class base httpx.BaseTransport is now found, so super() reaches httpx/_transports/base.py instead of an external base; the resolvedExternal delta is -7 net, so one site moved the other way and is not identified. Bin deltas on httpx re-measured after the fix, identical: in-repo +1140, nameNotBound -883, receiverNeedsInference -250, resolvedExternal -7 (sums to 0); 1142 distinct sites gained edges, 2 of them already had an edge; the other four repos are unchanged. The earlier modifiedFiles listing of modules.ts and test/python-modules.test.ts was wrong (neither is touched); corrected. A1 in-package value stays unmeasured.
